scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tighter text-ink
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-light tracking-tight text-ink
scale.kpi_value: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-light tracking-tighter text-[#111110] font-serif
scale.kpi_label: text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#6B6A68] font-sans

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Airy, magazine-style layouts with generous whitespace. Use grid lines to separate content instead of heavy boxes.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid (Control Room style) but with 'gap-8' to 'gap-12' for breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-lg (subtle 8px) for containers, rounded-full for pills/chips.

kpi_cards.style: Cardless or flat white surface. Top hairline border in Accent color or pure Ink. Massive serif typography for the value.
kpi_cards.classes: flex flex-col justify-between p-6 bg-white border border-[#E5E5E0] rounded-xl shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md

filter_bar.style: Top-aligned sticky bar with airy, minimal multiselect dropdowns. No heavy backgrounds.
filter_bar.classes: flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 py-4 mb-8 border-b border-[#E5E5E0] bg-[#F9F9F6]/80 backdrop-blur-xl z-50 sticky top-0

tabs.style: Editorial underline style. No pills. Bold ink for active, muted stone for inactive.
tabs.classes: flex gap-8 border-b border-[#E5E5E0] text-sm uppercase tracking-widest

charts.style: Minimalist Recharts. Remove outer grid lines, use hairline axes, clean tooltips with frosted glass.
charts.tooltip_classes: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-[#E5E5E0] p-4 shadow-xl rounded-lg font-sans text-sm

data_tables.style: Financial Times style. Hairline horizontal borders only. No vertical borders. Generous row padding.
data_tables.header_classes: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-[#6B6A68] border-b-2 border-[#111110] pb-4 text-left font-sans

heatmaps.style: Color-graded cells using the accent color (Terracotta) fading into off-white.

motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up (opacity 0 to 1, translateY 10px to 0) using framer-motion.
motion.hover: Subtle -translate-y-1 on cards, text color transitions on links (duration-200 ease-out).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text primary (#111110) against background (#F9F9F6) exceeds 7:1.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='filter-platform-select').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build an editorial-style dashboard using React, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, and Framer Motion.
Use standard JS files (not TSX) as this is a JS environment.
DO NOT use generic Shadcn heavy cards; strip them down to hairline borders and flat surfaces with ample padding.
Apply the typography scale strictly: 'Cormorant Garamond' for massive KPIs and main headers, 'Manrope' for body and UI elements.
Ensure the chart color palette mapped in 'colors.charts' is utilized for the Recharts components.
No auth or predictions functionality needed (skip them completely).
Layout should be top filter bar + dense but airy data grids beneath.
All complex interactions (multiselect, tabs) must be built using Shadcn UI primitives but styled to match the editorial guidelines (no default Vercel aesthetic).
Implement the explicit tabs/sections: Insights, ROAS Analysis, Geographic & Audience, CPC & Spend, Trends, Correlation.
